comparison_oracle: Predeclared source-bound states, exact opaque ordered-byte/chunk expectations and event traces authored before first future run. No candidate tensor adapter or metadata flag is an oracle for physical target behavior.
evidence_policy: Keep every future source/plan/fixture/result/log/failure version. Freeze membership and expectations before first run; fix only demonstrated failing harness nodes and retain failure history. No rerun of a passing/closed cohort.
future_success_can_establish: Only consistency of a synthetic requirements state model and supplied opaque byte stream; no actual build, alias exclusion, stream ordering, capture atomicity or performance.
